description.en: Managed Claude Code Messages accounts. SSH connections and credentials are managed by the core. Token counting and model discovery are not supported.
description.zh: 托管 Claude Code Messages 账号，SSH 连接与凭证由核心管理；支持流式响应及用量计费，不支持 token 预估与模型发现。

description.en: Uses the connection configured by administrators. No account key is required.
description.zh: 使用管理员设置的 CCGateway 连接，无需填写账号密钥。

reason.en: Register managed Claude Code accounts for Anthropic Messages
reason.zh: 为 Anthropic Messages 注册托管 Claude Code 账号

reason.en: Validate the empty credential object of managed accounts; connection secrets remain in the core
reason.zh: 校验托管账号的空凭证对象；连接密钥仍只由核心持有
